text: The physical exam confirms severe respiratory distress with tachypnea, retractions, and cyanosis. Given the history of prematurity (32 weeks), gestational diabetes, and C-section, combined with respiratory acidosis, I suspect Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn or meconium aspiration.
